about_the_game:
Did your hero’s village suffer a bandit attack but still look clean? Does a ruined and abandoned city still look like someone is caring for the roofs and town square? Then you need the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior pack! Winlu has created an add-on pack to their Fantasy Tileset series to help you show just how damaged a town has become. 4 versions of A3 tiles and 3 versions of B sheet tiles along with 2 more B sheets are perfectly set so you can swap out a full sheet to instantly turn a normal happy town into a busted ruin barely hanging on after the demon lord’s army passed through. Or mix and match the two sets to give specific spots of damage to buildings, such as a collapsed chimney and tile roof filled with holes making a house unlivable, at least until your heroes chip in to repair it!

This pack also includes tiles set up as characters so that you can easily add them to your maps. Top your bell towers and chapels with collapsing spires and thoughtfully place holes in every roof that reveal the interior support beams. Hang broken wooden signs over shop doors so that your heroes know what type of items they may find in the mostly-empty buildings, or use a busted sign as a marker for a shop that can be invested in and improved as your heroes get stronger and gather more money. If your game includes any attacks that destroy villages or you want to let your players slowly repair a town, pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior pack!


Contents:

-9 tilesheets
-4 Character sheets
- the destroyed version of the "Winlu Fantasy Exterior Tileset"
- Each tile has the same tile position as the main fantasy exterior tileset, so you can easy swap the tileset for the destroyed version


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
